{{Quote|I have one last introduction to make: This is Lieutenant Aric Jorgan, an operations officer from the Republic's Ord Mantell Infantry Command.|Havoc Squad Commander Harron Tavus introduces a new squad member|<ref name="Hit the Ground Running" />}}
'''Ord Mantell Infantry Command''' was a military organization in the [[Republic Army|army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] active on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==History==
{{Quote|Now, the reason we're all here: A Republic transport, carrying among its cargo a ZR-57 orbital strike bomb, crashed in northern Avilatan six days ago. Recovery unit sent a team, but they were too late. Separatist forces had already stolen the transport's cargo, including the ZR-57, and fled.|Commander Tavus briefs a new squad member on a mission|<ref name="Hit the Ground Running" />}}
During the [[Separatist War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="3643BBY">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Infantry Command was assigned to search for and recover a [[ZR-57 orbital strike bomb|ZR-57]] orbital strike [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] on the island of [[Avilatan]] that had been stolen by local separatist forces. Because the [[Republic Army]]'s elite [[Havoc Squad]] was assigned a similar [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Havoc Squad)|mission]], Infantry Command operations [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Aric Jorgan]] coordinated the activities of both units from the [[Government House (Fort Garnik)|command center]] at [[Fort Garnik]].<ref name="Hit the Ground Running" />

==Members==
===General Vander===
{{Quote|You must be our last loyal Havoc member. I'm General Vander, Republic chief of operations for Ord Mantell. It's a pleasure to finally meet you.|Gen. Vander greets a Havoc Squad member|<ref name="The Separatists' Stronghold" />}}
[[File:Vander.png|thumb|left|250px|Gen. Vander.]]
{{Main|Vander}}
Republic Army [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vander]] was the head of Infantry Command and chief of operations for the Republic on Ord Mantell in 3643 BBY. After the [[SpecForce Incident|defection]] of most the members of Havoc Squad to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Vander was compelled by his superiors to demote Lieutenant Jorgan and remove him from his post. To compensate Jorgan, Vander assigned him as the newest member of Havoc Squad.<ref name="The Separatists' Stronghold" /> Later that year, Vander contacted Jorgan to offer him reinstatement to his old post, a promotion, and command of operations on Ord Mantell, though Jorgan declined the offer and remained in Havoc Squad.<ref name="A New Home">{{TORcite|type=conversation|[[Aric Jorgan]]|A New Home}}</ref> In [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="3637BBY">{{TOR_updates|3.0}}</ref> Vander had since departed Infantry Command and led Republic military forces to victory in the liberation of the planet [[Altair 9]].<ref name="Mail Altair">{{TORcite|type=message|FWD: Republic Victory on Altair 9|[[M1-4X]]}}</ref>

===Lieutenant Aric Jorgan===
{{Quote|General, with all due respect, how can you do this? I've served with your Infantry Command for years.|Lieutenant Aric Jorgan protests his demotion to General Vander following Havoc Squad's defection|<ref name="The Separatists' Stronghold" />}}
[[File:Aric_Jorgan.png|thumb|right|250px|Lt. Aric Jorgan.]]
{{Main|Aric Jorgan}}
By 3643 BBY, Jorgan had already served in Ord Mantell Infantry Command for some [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="The Separatists' Stronghold" /> In that year, he was assigned as an operations officer in Infantry Command and was tasked with coordinating the efforts of his unit and Havoc Squad to recover the stolen ZR-57 bomb.<ref name="Hit the Ground Running" /> Following the defection of Havoc Squad, he was removed from his post and assigned to the unit.<ref name="The Separatists' Stronghold" /> He eventually ascended to the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Major/Legends|Major]] and became [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of Havoc Squad.<ref name="">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=11}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ord Mantell Infantry Command received a few direct mentions in the Republic Trooper class story on Ord Mantell in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Hit the Ground Running" />
